purpose: Known documented Earth analog sites. Used to label Earth candidates as 'known analog' or 'candidate, not confirmed analog'. A candidate is 'known' only if it lies within 1.5 degrees of one of these sites.
coordinate_warning: Coordinates verified against USGS GNIS, SCAR Composite Gazetteer, Earth Impact Database, and peer-reviewed literature.

sites.name: Atacama Desert, Chile
sites.description: Hyper-arid desert benchmark site for Mars analog studies (Yungay / central depression).

sites.name: Haughton impact crater, Devon Island, Canada
sites.description: Impact crater in a polar cold desert, primary Mars and Moon analog site (NASA Haughton-Mars Project).

sites.name: Death Valley, USA
sites.description: Arid basin with extreme diurnal temperature range and evaporite geology. USGS GNIS Feature ID 241416.

sites.name: Mauna Kea, Hawaii
sites.description: High-altitude basaltic volcanic terrain, lunar and Martian regolith analog. USGS GNIS Feature ID 362483.

sites.name: Craters of the Moon, Idaho, USA
sites.description: Basaltic lava flows and cinder cones, Apollo and planetary rover analog terrain. USGS GNIS ID 396395.

sites.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys, Antarctica
sites.description: Polar hyper-arid cold desert, permafrost and cryptoendolithic habitat Mars analog. SCAR Gazetteer ID 9253.
